name: Blow the Job
source:
Kim, a senior high school student was called again for help.

Dr. Bradley needs Kim to help people control their behavior.

Will Kim succeed in helping Dr. Bradley or will he make things worse for all of them?

[From [url=https://purple-bear.itch.io/blow-the-job]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
高中生金又一次被叫去帮忙。

布拉德利医生需要金协助人们控制自己的行为。

金能顺利帮上布拉德利医生的忙，还是会让所有人的处境变得更糟？
